seo.title: Safari Quest in Alaska: UnCruise's 22-Guest Yacht in Glacier Bay | James Wild & Co
seo.description: Safari Quest is UnCruise's smallest yacht: 22 guests, 11 cabins, a crew ratio of two guests to one. She sails Alaska's Glacier Wilderness week from Juneau and the Inside Passage from Seattle, 2027 and 2028, from $9,900.

safari-quest.tagline: Twenty-two guests, eleven cabins, and the coves even UnCruise's other boats cannot reach.
safari-quest.answer: Safari Quest is UnCruise's smallest yacht: 120 feet, 22 guests in 11 cabins, one crew member for every two guests. She sails Alaska's Glacier Wilderness, a week round trip from Juneau through Glacier Bay's outer reaches, Admiralty Island and Dawes Glacier, from May to September, and the Inside Passage between Seattle and Juneau in spring and autumn. Fares run from $9,900 per person; the whole yacht can be chartered.
overview: UnCruise built its Alaska fleet around access, and Safari Quest is the sharpest end of it. At 120 feet she reaches wilderness areas with the tightest permits, where no more than two groups of twelve may go ashore in a day. For those, UnCruise says, she is the ticket in.

Four decks hold a lounge and dining room, a small library, an open bridge, a hot tub on the observation deck and eleven cabins, the Admirals on the bridge deck. Meals are served at table; every drink is included.

Her Alaska summer is one week, repeated: Juneau round trip by Icy Strait, Chichagof, Admiralty Island, Warm Springs Bay, Frederick Sound and Dawes Glacier. In May and September she also sails the twelve nights between Seattle and Juneau.
why: Twenty-two guests: a whole yacht for one family or a group of friends, or a week that feels like it.
Permit-limited wilderness, ashore in groups of twelve or fewer.
Frederick Sound for humpback, killer, minke and fin whales, and Admiralty Island, the island of the bears.

faqs: How many guests does Safari Quest carry?
22, in 11 cabins, with a guest to crew ratio of two to one.
Where does Safari Quest sail in Alaska?
Alaska's Glacier Wilderness, seven nights round trip from Juneau, from May to September; and between Seattle and Juneau, twelve nights, in May and September.
Can we charter Safari Quest?
Yes. UnCruise offers her as a full ship on every sailing; ask us for the rate.
Is Wi-Fi available?
Yes, except inside national parks, preserves and protected areas, where there is none.

seo.title: Safari Explorer in Alaska: UnCruise's 36-Guest Expedition Yacht | James Wild & Co
seo.description: Safari Explorer, UnCruise's 36-guest expedition yacht, sails Prince William Sound, the Aleutian Islands and Alaska's wild Gulf coast in summer. Every 2027 and 2028 sailing and fare, from $11,200.

safari-explorer.tagline: Thirty-six guests to Alaska's far coast: Prince William Sound, the Gulf of Alaska and the Aleutians.
safari-explorer.answer: Safari Explorer is UnCruise's 36-guest expedition yacht, 145 feet with 18 cabins. In summer she sails Alaska's farther waters: Prince William Sound from Seward, the Aleutian Islands between Seward and Dutch Harbor, the Gulf coast between Seward and Juneau, and the Inside Passage from Seattle. Fares run from $11,200 per person.
overview: Safari Explorer winters in Hawaii and comes north for the summer, to the parts of Alaska most small ships never reach. Her rugged hull and small size take her into remote waterways with room for only a few.

Three decks: a rooftop sun lounge, fitness equipment, an open bridge and the Commodore Suites up top, a hot tub in Alaska, the dining room and lounge below. Meals are plated, every drink is included, and there are kayaks, paddleboards, skiffs, snorkel gear and rubber boots for everyone.

In 2027 she sails the Aleutian Islands Adventure six times, Kodiak, Katmai and Aniakchak to Dutch Harbor; Prince William Sound with Cordova; Alaska's Coastal Treasures to Juneau; and the Inside Passage south to Seattle in September.
why: The Aleutians: Katmai, Aniakchak and Akutan, on a route very few ships sail.
Thirty-six guests, with two balcony cabins and Commodore Suites on the bridge deck.
The Gulf of Alaska coast: Kayak Island, Icy Bay, Hubbard Glacier and Lituya Bay.

Yes: in 2027 she sails the Aleutian Islands Adventure, ten nights between Seward and Dutch Harbor, six times between June and August.
What is included?
Meals, all drinks, port fees and taxes, and the kayaks, paddleboards and skiffs. Gratuities are not.

seo.title: Wilderness Adventurer: UnCruise's 60-Guest Ship in Glacier Bay | James Wild & Co
seo.description: Wilderness Adventurer, UnCruise's 60-guest expedition ship, sails Glacier Bay weekly from Juneau, Misty Fjords to Ketchikan and the Denali land and sea journey. Every 2027 and 2028 sailing and fare, from $5,300.

wilderness-adventurer.tagline: Sixty guests, built for action: Glacier Bay twice a week, kayaks off the stern.
wilderness-adventurer.answer: Wilderness Adventurer is a 60-guest UnCruise expedition ship, 160 feet with 30 cabins. From April to September she sails the Glacier Bay Adventure, seven nights round trip from Juneau with two days in the park, plus spring and autumn weeks to Ketchikan and the Denali to Glacier Bay land and sea journey. Fares run from $5,300 per person.
overview: UnCruise built Wilderness Adventurer for doing things: an EZ Dock launch platform off the main deck puts guests in kayaks and paddleboards straight from the ship, and there are snorkel gear and wetsuits aboard for the brave.
A hot tub and fitness equipment on the sun deck, an observation deck at the bow, and a lounge with a live GPS map and a camera under the bow. Meals are buffet and plated; every drink is included.
Her season is mostly one week: Juneau, Tracy Arm or another tidewater glacier, Frederick Sound, Chichagof's brown bears and two full days in Glacier Bay.
why: Two full days in Glacier Bay National Park, every week.
Straight into the water from the EZ Dock: kayaks, paddleboards and snorkelling.
Compass single cabins, so solo travellers pay no single supplement on those.

seo.title: Wilderness Explorer: UnCruise's 74-Guest Expedition Ship in Alaska | James Wild & Co
seo.description: Wilderness Explorer, UnCruise's 74-guest expedition vessel, sails Northern Passages to Sitka, Prince William Sound, the Aleutians and Alaska's Coastal Treasures. Every 2027 and 2028 sailing and fare, from $7,300.

wilderness-explorer.tagline: The salty one: the only UnCruise boat to have wintered in Southeast Alaska, twice.
wilderness-explorer.answer: Wilderness Explorer is UnCruise's 74-guest expedition vessel, 185 feet with 37 cabins. She sails the widest range of Alaska routes in the fleet: Northern Passages between Juneau and Sitka, Prince William Sound from Seward, the Aleutians in 2028, Alaska's Coastal Treasures, and the Inside Passage from Seattle. Fares run from $7,300 per person.
overview: UnCruise calls her daring and a wee bit salty: a strong sea boat and the only one in the fleet to have spent two winters in Southeast Alaska.

Three decks: an open bridge and covered seating on the sun deck, a lounge with wrap-around glass, a bar and a hot tub at the bow, the dining room and EZ Dock below. Every drink is included, at meals and in the lounge.
In 2027 she sails Northern Passages in summer, Prince William Sound in August and the long Coastal Treasures route; in 2028 she takes over the Aleutian Islands Adventure.
why: The most varied Alaska season in the fleet, from Sitka to Dutch Harbor.
A bow hot tub and a wrap-around glass lounge for the wildlife watching.
Compass single cabins for solo travellers.

seo.title: Wilderness Discoverer: UnCruise's 76-Guest Ship, Glacier Bay and Misty Fjords | James Wild & Co
seo.description: Wilderness Discoverer, UnCruise's 76-guest ship, sails the Glacier Bay Adventure from Juneau and Alaska's Fjords and Glaciers to Ketchikan, with Families in Nature and Adult Escape weeks. Every 2027 and 2028 sailing and fare, from $4,900.

wilderness-discoverer.tagline: A shoal draft, a bar carved from a Peril Strait cedar, and Glacier Bay twice a week.
wilderness-discoverer.answer: Wilderness Discoverer is a 76-guest UnCruise ship, 174 feet with 38 cabins and a shoal draft that takes her into water closed to bigger boats. She sails the Glacier Bay Adventure from Juneau and Alaska's Fjords and Glaciers between Juneau and Ketchikan, with Families in Nature, Adult Escape and photography weeks. Fares run from $4,900 per person, the lowest in UnCruise's Alaska fleet.
overview: She was the first of UnCruise's Wilderness boats, and the one that set the company on its path to bigger adventures. Her bar top and tap tower are cut from a yellow cedar log found in Peril Strait.
Three decks, two hot tubs, an EZ Dock for kayaks and paddleboards, snorkel gear and wetsuits, and a lounge with a GPS map, wildlife books and binoculars. Every drink is included.
Her Alaska is the Inside Passage classic: Glacier Bay twice a week from Juneau, and in spring and summer the run south past Dawes Glacier, Wrangell Narrows and Misty Fjords to Ketchikan.
why: The lowest fares in UnCruise's Alaska fleet, from $4,900.
Families in Nature and Adult Escape weeks, and a photography week with Lisa Mize.
Two hot tubs, and five cabins that sleep three.

seo.title: Safari Endeavour: UnCruise's 86-Guest Ship, Northern Passages to Sitka | James Wild & Co
seo.description: Safari Endeavour, UnCruise's 86-guest ship with balcony suites, sails Northern Passages between Juneau and Sitka and the Inside Passage from Seattle. Every 2027 and 2028 sailing and fare, from $6,300.

safari-endeavour.tagline: Eighty-six guests, two hot tubs and balcony suites, between Juneau and Sitka.
safari-endeavour.answer: Safari Endeavour is an 86-guest UnCruise ship, 230 feet with 43 cabins, four of them with balconies. All summer she sails Northern Passages, seven nights between Juneau and Sitka by Glacier Bay, Chichagof and Peril Strait, and in spring and autumn the twelve nights between Seattle and Juneau. Fares run from $6,300 per person.
overview: The longest of UnCruise's Alaska boats, with four guest decks: lounge chairs and fitness on the sun deck, two outdoor hot tubs, a bow viewing area, a lounge, a library and the dining room.
On days the excursions run through lunch, the galley packs boxed lunches so no one has to come back early. Every drink is included. The Commodore Suites have private balconies and a tub.
Her Alaska week is UnCruise's only route through Sitka Sound and Peril Strait, with a day in Glacier Bay and a day for Chichagof's bears; Adult Escape weeks run in May, July and September.
why: The only UnCruise route through Sitka Sound and Peril Strait.
Commodore Suites with private balconies.
Adult Escape weeks for travellers who want a ship without children.

seo.title: Wilderness Legacy: UnCruise's 88-Guest Ship, Wild, Woolly and Wow | James Wild & Co
seo.description: Wilderness Legacy, UnCruise's largest Alaska ship at 88 guests, sails Wild, Woolly and Wow from Juneau: LeConte Glacier, Kuiu Island, Chichagof and Glacier Bay, the fleet's most active week. Every 2027 and 2028 sailing and fare, from $5,300.

wilderness-legacy.tagline: UnCruise's largest Alaska ship, on its most active week.
wilderness-legacy.answer: Wilderness Legacy is UnCruise's largest Alaska vessel: 192 feet, 88 guests in 44 cabins, with the most spacious viewing decks in the fleet and its only elevator. From April to September she sails Wild, Woolly and Wow, seven nights round trip from Juneau to LeConte Glacier, Kuiu Island, Chichagof and Glacier Bay's outer bay, the most active week UnCruise offers. Fares run from $5,300 per person.
overview: Carved wooden cabinetry, an Owner's Suite and a whistle she blows on arrival: the Legacy is the character of the fleet. Her Sea Dragon platform launches kayaks and paddleboards, and three bow viewing areas give the best wildlife watching in the fleet.

Four decks: two hot tubs and the open bridge up top, the largest lounge in the Alaska fleet, and a dining room serving plated meals. Every drink is included. She is the only boat with an elevator, though it does not reach the bridge deck.

Her week is Wild, Woolly and Wow: bushwhacks in old growth, LeConte Glacier up a channel big ships cannot enter, Thomas Bay's falls, black bears on Kuiu, brown bears on Chichagof and Glacier Bay's rarely visited outer bay.
why: UnCruise's most active Alaska week.
Families in Nature and Adult Escape departures, and a week hosted with the National Forest Foundation.
The only elevator in the fleet, and Jr. Commodore and Commodore suites.

What is Wild, Woolly and Wow?
Seven nights round trip from Juneau: Robert and Crow, LeConte Glacier, Thomas Bay, Kuiu Island, Chichagof Island and Glacier Bay's outer bay. UnCruise calls it its most active expedition cruise.
Is she suitable for guests with limited mobility?
She is the only boat in the fleet with an elevator (not to the bridge deck), but guests must manage the gangway and one flight of stairs; ask us before you book.
